code_with:
import os
import requests

token = os.environ["SPOTIFY_ACCESS_TOKEN"]
headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {token}"}

# Get the current user's ID using the documented search endpoint is not possible;
# create-playlist requires a user ID, so obtain it from the authenticated user's
# playlist data if available.
playlists_response = requests.get(
    "https://api.spotify.com/v1/me/playlists",
    headers=headers,
    params={"limit": 1},
)
playlists_response.raise_for_status()

# Spotify's documented playlist-creation endpoint requires the user's ID.
# Use the owner ID from an existing playlist; if none exists, provide the user ID
# via SPOTIFY_USER_ID.
playlists = playlists_response.json().get("items", [])
user_id = (
    playlists[0]["owner"]["id"]
    if playlists
    else os.environ["SPOTIFY_USER_ID"]
)

playlist_response = requests.post(
    f"https://api.spotify.com/v1/users/{user_id}/playlists",
    headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"name": "Love Mariah", "public": False},
)
playlist_response.raise_for_status()
playlist_id = playlist_response.json()["id"]

search_response = requests.get(
    "https://api.spotify.com/v1/search",
    headers=headers,
    params={"q": "artist:Mariah Carey", "type": "track", "limit": 3},
)
search_response.raise_for_status()
tracks = search_response.json().get("tracks", {}).get("items", [])

if len(tracks) < 3:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not find three Mariah Carey tracks.")

add_response = requests.post(
    f"https://api.spotify.com/v1/playlists/{playlist_id}/tracks",
    headers={**headers, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
    json={"uris": [track["uri"] for track in tracks[:3]]},
)
add_response.raise_for_status()
